t: G32 Eco-Regeneration Engine: Logistic Growth Modeler — Simple
name: G32 Eco-Regeneration Engine: Logistic Growth Modeler — Simple
title: G32 Eco-Regeneration Engine: Logistic Growth Modeler — Simple
description:
[REAL ENGINEERING] Populations grow logistically: dN/dt = rN(1−N/K), fast when small, leveling at carrying capacity K. The modeler computes the equilibrium and the time to reach 90% of K — the two numbers every stocking or planting plan needs.

Start here. In plain terms: Headline number: Growth rate at N=400, K=1000, r=0.5 = 120.0 individuals/yr. The rest of this record keeps every number honest — each claim below was recomputed, not copied.
chapter_source: The Perpetual Eco-Regeneration Engine (G32) – Quantifying the Bio-Sustainability Constant (BSC)
real_world_basis: Logistic growth is the real, standard model of managed populations.
signature_version: Signature version: the BSC modeler — the chapter's Bio-Sustainability Constant as the harvest rule target (maximum sustainable yield at K/2), with the 'perpetual' framing labeled concept.
build_steps: Build: estimate K from the habitat, r from history, then set the stocking plan.
math_note: Growth rate at N=400, K=1000, r=0.5: 120.0 individuals/yr [verified]; Growth rate at N=900 (near capacity): 45.0 individuals/yr [verified]

math_check.label: Growth rate at N=400, K=1000, r=0.5

safety: Ecological safety: never stock past K — the model is the guardrail.
how_it_works: Fit r and K from field data, compute the equilibrium (N=K) and the 90% time from the closed form. The demo models a fishery recovery.
requirements: Re-run the demo program to re-verify every number
standards: Full-file record, never a stub
Speculative = Signature-labeled, never as established fact
Every numerical claim recomputed at build time

t: G32 Eco-Regeneration Engine: Reforestation Budget Desk — Simple
name: G32 Eco-Regeneration Engine: Reforestation Budget Desk — Simple
title: G32 Eco-Regeneration Engine: Reforestation Budget Desk — Simple
description:
[REAL ENGINEERING] Trees per hectare × hectares × survival rate = the planting order; cost = order × price per seedling plus labor. The desk computes the order and the budget, then sizes the nursery lead time — reforestation is logistics wearing a green coat.

Start here. In plain terms: Headline number: Seedlings for 50 ha at 1200/ha, 80% survival = 75000 seedlings. The rest of this record keeps every number honest — each claim below was recomputed, not copied.

title: G32 Eco-Regeneration Engine: Soil Carbon Ledger — Simple
description:
[REAL ENGINEERING] Soil carbon is the slow bank account: inputs from litter and roots, outputs from respiration, and the ledger tracks the balance. The ledger computes the sequestration rate from measured stocks — carbon claims without a ledger are stories.

Start here. In plain terms: Headline number: Sequestration: 42 to 48 t/ha over 5 years = 1.20 t/ha/yr. The rest of this record keeps every number honest — each claim below was recomputed, not copied.

build_steps: Build: baseline first, practice second, remeasure third.

safety: No hazard; the failure mode is claiming sequestration without remeasurement.
